categories: [project, grant]
---

Snowlines on the Tasman Glacier are the focus of a Royal Society Te Apārangi Catalyst
project that began in October 2025. The project draws on polarimetric data from the
RADARSAT Constellation Mission, with Rodrigo Gomez-Fell as an Associate Investigator. See the
[project description](../projects.qmd#rcm-glaciers).
